What we do · Чем мы занимаемся

EPC-adjacent pipe engineering for industrial Moscow

SeverTub is an engineer-led piping practice supporting owners, operators, and EPC contractors across the Central Federal District. We take piping packages from conceptual routing and P&ID coordination through stress analysis, isometrics, fabrication oversight, welding QA, and site installation support, the adjacent workstream that keeps process and utility systems buildable.

Our scope spans process piping (transfer, reactor feed, chemical service) and utility piping (steam, condensate, cooling water, compressed air, fire water, district heating). Typical diameters run DN50–DN1200 in carbon steel, stainless (304/316L and equivalents), and selected alloy grades, with wall schedules and flange classes set to media, pressure, and northern climate duty.

Deliverables are shop- and field-ready: stress reports and support schedules, isometric/spool packages with MTOs, WPS/PQR review and weld maps, cold-climate insulation and support interfaces, and turnaround/retrofit tie-in packages planned for tight outage windows. We work fluently across GOST practice and ISO/ASME expectations under founder and Co-CEO Chris E Dunn and Co-CEO Dimitri Kevin Abdulov.

  • Process & utility piping layout
  • Pipe stress & support design
  • Isometrics, spools & MTO
  • P&ID markups & consistency checks
  • Fabrication oversight
  • Welding QA / NDT coordination
  • Turnaround & brownfield retrofit
  • Cold-climate insulation & supports

Services · Услуги

Capabilities across the piping lifecycle

From conceptual layout to turnaround retrofit: engineer-led deliverables your fabricators and site teams can execute.

Pipe stress & layout engineering

3D routing, hanger/support schedules, expansion loops, and code stress analysis for process and utility lines under thermal, pressure, and seismic cases, including cold-startup scenarios.

Material specifications

Carbon steel, stainless, and alloy grades; wall schedules; flanges, fittings, and gaskets aligned to media, PN/class, and northern climate exposure.

Isometric & P&ID support

Isometrics, spool drawings, P&ID markups, line lists, and bill-of-materials packages ready for shop fabrication and procurement.

Site supervision & fab oversight

Shop and field installation oversight, fit-up and dimensional checks, and coordination with civil and mechanical trades on industrial sites.

Welding QA

WPS/PQR review, welder qualification checks, NDT coordination, and weld-map alignment with GOST / ISO / ASME project specs.

Retrofit & turnaround piping

Brownfield tie-ins, shutdown piping scopes, and replacement packages sequenced for minimal outage windows, including cold-climate insulation rework.

Pipe projects we have worked on

Representative scopes from recent SeverTub delivery. Client identities kept confidential at owner request.

District heating · Moscow Oblast

District heating mains upgrade

Scope
Buried pre-insulated heating mains replacement on a municipal ТЭЦ feeder corridor: routing, stress, supports, and construction packages for a phased cutover.
Pipework
DN400–DN800 carbon steel, factory pre-insulated (PUR + jacket), PN16/PN25 duty with compensators and fixed-point design for frost heave and thermal expansion.
Delivered
Layout & stress package, support schedule, isometrics/MTO, insulation interface notes, and site fit-up support during tie-in weekends.

Outcome: Two feeder legs cut over on plan with no winter heating outage beyond the approved shut-in window.

DN400–800 Buried pre-insulated GOST + EN Site support

Chemical · Confidential client

Process stainless transfer lines

Scope
Unit expansion transfer and recirculation lines for a chemical intermediate: P&ID alignment, alloy selection, and fabricable isometric set.
Pipework
DN50–DN200 stainless (316L / equiv.), butt-weld and flanged classes, heat-traced runs where crystallization risk required winterization.
Delivered
Stress & layout, full isometric/spool package with MTO, WPS review for stainless procedures, and fabrication oversight at the preferred shop.

Outcome: Spools accepted first-pass; hydrotest and NDT completed inside the mechanical completion gate.

SS 316L DN50–200 P&ID support Fab oversight

Midstream · Pump station

Pump station interconnect piping

Scope
Interconnect piping between new booster pumps, suction/discharge manifolds, and existing trunk tie-ins at a midstream transfer station.
Pipework
DN250–DN600 carbon steel, ASME B31.3 / GOST-aligned class, surge and thermal cases for start/stop and cold-weather restart.
Delivered
3D routing & stress, support and anchor design, isometric package, and site supervision for manifold fit-up and flange management.

Outcome: Station returned to dual-pump operation on the agreed mechanical completion date.

DN250–600 CS B31.3 Site QA

Industrial utilities · Boiler house

Boiler house steam & condensate headers

Scope
Steam and condensate header redesign for an industrial boiler house serving process loads, including drain/trap philosophy and cold-start warm-up paths.
Pipework
DN100–DN400 carbon steel steam (superheated / saturated duty) and condensate return; guides, hangers, and insulation for outdoor and indoor runs.
Delivered
Layout & stress, isometric set, trap/drain schedule, WPS review, and turnaround installation plan with weld maps.

Outcome: Header replacement executed in a single planned outage; water-hammer complaints eliminated on restart.

Steam / condensate DN100–400 Turnaround WPS review

Water · Treatment plant

Water treatment process piping package

Scope
Process piping package for a municipal/industrial water treatment train: chemical dosing, filter backwash, and clarified-water transfer.
Pipework
DN80–DN500 carbon and stainless lines; lined sections where chemistry required; utility compressed air and wash-water loops included.
Delivered
P&ID support, layout, isometrics/MTO, material specs, and fabrication oversight through hydrotest documentation handover.

Outcome: Package handed to the EPC installer with zero major RFIs on spool geometry during construction.

DN80–500 CS / SS Design + fab MTO

Brownfield · Industrial plant

Cold-climate utility retrofit

Scope
Winterization retrofit of exposed utility corridors (cooling water, fire water, and instrument air) after freeze-damage incidents on an industrial campus.
Pipework
DN50–DN300 CS utilities; heat tracing interfaces, insulation thickness schedules, and revised support spacing for snow/ice loads.
Delivered
Survey-based as-built markups, insulation & support redesign, isometric rework packages, and site supervision through recommissioning.

Outcome: Utilities survived the following winter season without freeze-related trips on the retrofitted corridors.

Utilities Insulation −50°C mindset Site support
